{{Databank|darius-pax|Darius Pax}} places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Racer]]''{{#if: {{{1|}}}|, including {{{1}}},|}} [[Standard year|years]] after the [[New Republic]] was founded, which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[4 ABY]], meaning the game takes place during or after [[6 ABY]]. As it takes place before the New Republic was destroyed, in [[34 ABY]] per ''Galactic Atlas'', the game takes place between 6 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]] and 34 ABY.<noinclude>
